glosses: rent (payment made by a tenant at intervals in order to occupy a property)

examples.text: Ele tem renda suficiente para manter sua família.
examples.en: He has a sufficient income to support his family.

examples.text: Nunca desista e nunca se renda.
examples.en: Never give up and never surrender.

examples.text: Qual é a sua principal fonte de renda?
examples.en: What's your main source of income?

examples.text: É difícil conviver com esta pequena renda.
examples.en: It is hard to get along on this small income.
